hypotheses.claim: Normalizing the generalized savings expression by a single global depot-distance scale mean(d(0,1..n)) — instead of the per-pair local ratio (d0i+d0j-dij)/(d0i+d0j) — preserves the radial priority of far-from-depot customers while keeping exact coordinate-scale invariance, so a lam/mu/beta-tuned one-shot vectorized scoring hook on cvrp_parallel_merge_static with postprocess_mode='none' will beat bare Clarke-Wright (16.2225) and CW+relocate+2opt (16.1549) on dev_hetero_24, reaching mean_tour_length <~16.15 within the 25 ms budget with zero timeout truncations.

next_search_advice.direction: Refine the globally depot-distance-scale-normalized generalized Clarke-Wright savings rule for L2a static merge: single vectorized pre-loop scoring using lam in [1.00,1.15] on d(i,j), mu in [0.08,0.15] radial asymmetry term |d(0,i)-d(0,j)|, plus a light dimensionless capacity-fill reward beta in [0.05,0.15] on clip((q_i+q_j)/Q,0,1) and an optional endpoint demand-balance term; strictly forbid per-pair (d0i+d0j) normalization.
